title: Vintage Trailer North of  Nashville
description:
Reconnect with the simple things in life at this unforgettable location.  Stay in our 1964 travel trailer, Betty-Lou.  She’s a fully enclosed home away from home.   
There’s lots of space to lounge outdoors in a hammock or in front of the fire pit. You will be close to Nashville but away from all the traffic and noise.  

Betty-Lou is famous.  She has been used in videos, including “Ashes” by Bailey Zimmerman

The space
Betty-Lou is a 1964 Holiday Rambler.  She is fully equipped with a bathroom, shower, sink, stove, oven, fridge, microwave, queen size bed and dining area.  Both heat and air conditioning.    
Outside you have access to a fire pit, hammocks, and a fabulous deck for lounging.  
Not shown- there is an awning covered deck with a picnic table at the entrance to the RV. Great for morning coffee and taking your meals outdoors.

Guest access
Guests have access to the front and back yards, including the lower part of our two level deck.

Other things to note
We have two dogs on the property.
You must check in on the first day before 9 pm.
